@graph.name: 3 Day Bromo, Madakaripura & Ijen Overland from Surabaya to Bali

review.reviewBody: We had the best time on our 3D2N Java to Bali trip with JVTO. Rendi was a wonderful guide, super funny, punctual, knowledgeable and he takes the best photos! He answered all of our questions and gave us fun facts throughout the tour. He also speaks good English which made it easy to communicate. He introduced us to a lot of his guide friends, making for a very warm and welcoming atmosphere.\n\nAll our concerns were quickly and easily resolved. Our driver Didin was also very kind. My friends and I had a lot of fun thanks to the team. I would highly recommend Java Volcano Tour Operator.
